question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

We should _______ their directions if we want to reach there.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**follow**" means to go or come after a person or thing proceeding ahead; to adhere to instructions or a path. (अनुसरण करना)
 
• In the given context, it suggests adhering to the directions given to reach a destination.
 
• The other options: "**obey**", "**run**", and "**mind**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** We should follow__ their directions if we want to reach there.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Obey (मानना)**: means to comply with the command, direction, or request of a person or law. 

 
 
• **Example:** Children should obey their parents.
 
 
 
• **Run (दौड़ना)**: means to move swiftly on foot. 
 
 
• **Example:** He runs five miles every morning.
 
 
 
• **Mind (ध्यान देना)**: means to be mindful of and give heed to. 
 
 
• **Example:** Please mind your manners at the dinner table.
